title: [review] tx_queue.rs: Latency truncation from u64 to u32
description: Casts (now_ms - enqueue_time_ms) to u32, truncating if latency exceeds ~49 days. Not reachable given DEADLINE_BULK_MS max of 120s, but if caller passes bogus timestamps, max_latency_ms and avg_latency_ms statistics become incorrect.
